value.rationale: Completes the natural Fredholm essential-spectrum and all-polynomial index classification for an operator family whose ordinary spectrum is known but conceals a topological branching dichotomy. End count controls the index, whereas infinitely many branch points force an entire disk of infinite cokernel; this is useful structural information unavailable from ordinary spectrum alone.
